observations.finding: 系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 equals the audited media_permission hint. Apple's zh-cn help (support.apple.com/zh-cn/guide/mac-help-cn/mchla1b1e1fe) returned HTTP 429 again; a web search surfaced third-party guides (pconline.com.cn/ask/377980.html, php.cn/faq/1970454.html) naming 系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 for Ventura and later — secondary evidence only. “允许” quoted like agent_tab_hint.

Round-2 remediation (748f4c83caf) made blocked_hint a devices select, resolving the a2 source observation (“them” for one device); the component now passes devices (browser-media-permission-prompt.tsx:152). Names the device(s) explicitly (麦克风 / 摄像头 / 摄像头和麦克风), matching the band's terms; “允许” quoted in every arm.
